purpose: Define one credential-safe, fixed-symbol, no-return source acceptance for customer-funded demand backlog without sweeping balance-sheet fields, report versions, formulas, directions, dates, prices, or returns.

mechanism_identity.economic_mechanism: A larger same-fiscal-quarter increase in contract liabilities relative to the issuer's current asset base represents more customer consideration received before revenue recognition and therefore a stronger disclosed demand backlog.

relationship_to_existing_factors.earnings_and_margin: No revenue, profit, EPS, ROE, gross-margin, forecast, express, or income-statement field is requested or derived.
relationship_to_existing_factors.cash_conversion: No cash-flow or income-statement field is used; the factor measures a specific customer obligation balance rather than cash backing of earnings.
relationship_to_existing_factors.balance_sheet_resilience: The terminal resilience factor used total liabilities divided by total assets. This factor uses the year-over-year change in one operating-liability component and must later pass an explicit no-return near-neighbor comparison.
relationship_to_existing_factors.asset_growth: Current total assets are only a scale denominator; the factor does not use total-asset growth or any beginning-of-year asset field.
relationship_to_existing_factors.ownership_orderflow_and_price: No holder identity, ownership concentration, order flow, OHLCV, technical indicator, auction, minute, Level-2, score, or return field is used.

source.documented_request_scope: one stock's history per standard request
source.request_date_semantics: start_date and end_date filter announcement dates; end_date in the response is the financial report period
source.forbidden_fields: Every balancesheet output field other than the exact requested_fields whitelist, including cash, receivables, inventories, goodwill, debt, lease liabilities, total liabilities, equity, working-capital components, names, prices, market values, scores, and returns.

point_in_time_and_version_policy.complete_integer_non_target_company_type: exclude and count every complete integer comp_type other than 1; never infer its business meaning or map it into type 1
point_in_time_and_version_policy.update_flag_policy: Require a complete value and count it for audit only. Never use update_flag to select, rank, repair, or replace a statement row.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.type_one_version_policy: For one instrument and report period, accept report_type 1 only when every complete candidate row has one identical ann_date, f_ann_date, contract_liab, and total_assets tuple. Exact semantic duplicates may collapse and be counted; differing tuples make the period ambiguous and exclude it.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.adjustment_precedence: The presence of any adjustment report type for comp_type 1 excludes the whole report period before type-one selection, even when an otherwise usable type-one row exists.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.missing_metric_policy: If any candidate type-one row has missing or nonfinite contract_liab or total_assets, exclude and count the whole period; never fill it from another row, report type, period, field, or provider.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.date_policy: ann_date, f_ann_date, and end_date must be complete strict YYYYMMDD dates; f_ann_date must not precede ann_date; end_date must not follow ann_date and must be a standard 0331, 0630, 0930, or 1231 quarter end.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.year_over_year_pair: Match only the same instrument and exact same fiscal quarter shifted back one calendar year after both periods independently pass the frozen version policy.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.prior_year_availability_check: The prior accepted f_ann_date must be strictly earlier than the current accepted f_ann_date.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.same_signal_date_multi_period_policy: If one instrument has multiple derived report periods on the same f_ann_date, retain only the latest report period and count the older simultaneous events.
point_in_time_and_version_policy.conservative_availability: first local trading session strictly after the current accepted f_ann_date
point_in_time_and_version_policy.residual_risk: The standard endpoint is a current vendor snapshot rather than an immutable historical revision tape. Excluding adjustment and ambiguous periods and waiting until the next local session reduces but cannot eliminate historical revision risk.

factor.name: tushare_contract_liability_backlog_delta
factor.units: dimensionless share of current total assets
factor.contract_liability_policy: Both current and prior contract_liab must be finite and nonnegative; a missing or negative value excludes and counts the pair.
factor.total_assets_policy: Current total_assets must be finite and strictly positive; prior total_assets is validated at its own period but is not used in the formula.
factor.nonfinite_derived_value_policy: exclude and count the pair; never offset or impute

acceptance_request.request_order: outer loop fixed_symbols_in_order, inner loop fixed_announcement_date_slices_in_order
